checked_items.notes: No live refresh or production CLI adapter is implemented in this delivery slice. The app has no direct-host or network implementation.
The fixture-backed menu surface models all named states, hosts, and queue rows, but live-fleet completeness is not yet implemented or verified.

evidence.title: Progressive fixture-backed host, job, and lane detail

checked_items.notes: The model and view hierarchy cover the required detail fields against fixtures, but the live CLI source and full retry or recoverable-failure history remain follow-up work.
Polling and the prerequisite CLI load test are intentionally deferred.
Alert evaluation and macOS notifications are intentionally deferred.
Notification modes and deduplication are intentionally deferred.
Stale, incompatible, unavailable, and retained-last-state presentations are modeled and unit tested, but live CLI failures are not yet exercised.

evidence.title: App and template menu-bar icon assets

checked_items.notes: The approved artwork and transparent template derivatives are integrated. Light and dark appearance legibility still requires screenshot evidence.
Distribution signing and Sparkle are intentionally deferred.

evidence.title: Model tests and packaged-app smoke harness

checked_items.notes: Twelve tests cover overview, freshness, preview isolation, and selection without launching AppKit; a packaged-app smoke test verifies launch and clean teardown. Parsing, refresh policy, and alert deduplication remain unimplemented.
Per-PR token burn cannot be measured until the live contract and historical reporting slices are deployed.

completion_claim: This execution completed only the CRUMAC-6 native foundation: a fixture-backed menu-bar and dashboard shell, asset integration, model tests, build/run tooling, and smoke verification. It does not claim any ProductSpec acceptance criterion or success metric is fully complete.
